lines.en: Kenji, look at this photo. This landmark had been built long before the railway reached Manchester.
lines.pt: Kenji, olhe esta foto. Este marco tinha sido construído muito antes de a ferrovia chegar a Manchester.

lines.en: Really? I thought the mill had been built after the canal opened, Mo.
lines.pt: Sério? Achei que o moinho tinha sido construído depois da abertura do canal, Mo.

lines.en: No. The guide said the canal had been dug years before, and the first warehouses had been finished by then.
lines.pt: Não. O guia disse que o canal tinha sido escavado anos antes, e os primeiros armazéns já tinham sido concluídos.

lines.en: So the cotton had already been carried by boat when the textile factory was opened?
lines.pt: Então o algodão já tinha sido transportado de barco quando a fábrica têxtil foi inaugurada?

lines.en: Exactly. Many workers had been hired before the machines were even installed.
lines.pt: Exato. Muitos operários tinham sido contratados antes de as máquinas serem instaladas.

lines.en: And the old town hall? It had been demolished in the war, hadn’t it?
lines.pt: E a antiga prefeitura? Tinha sido demolida na guerra, não?

lines.en: Only part of it. The tower had been saved, and the foundations had been repaired by the fifties.
lines.pt: Só uma parte. A torre tinha sido salva, e as fundações tinham sido reparadas nos anos cinquenta.

lines.en: Interesting. The museum says the first public library had been opened before the city became rich.
lines.pt: Interessante. O museu diz que a primeira biblioteca pública tinha sido aberta antes de a cidade ficar rica.

lines.en: Yes, and the streets around it had been paved only a few years before that.
lines.pt: Sim, e as ruas ao redor tinham sido pavimentadas poucos anos antes.

lines.en: I did not know so much had been done so early. I had expected a younger city.
lines.pt: Eu não sabia que tanta coisa já tinha sido feita tão cedo. Esperava uma cidade mais jovem.

lines.en: Most visitors say the same. Everything had been planned long before we were alive!
lines.pt: A maioria dos visitantes diz o mesmo. Tudo tinha sido planejado muito antes de existirmos!

facts.label: Past perfect passivo
facts.sub: Algo já feito antes de outro momento passado: It had been built long before. The canal had been dug earlier. Negativa: hadn’t been.

facts.label: Já tinha sido
facts.sub: Use had been + particípio para dizer que algo já tinha sido feito antes de outro momento do passado: The mill had been built before the canal.

facts.label: Contar o passado
facts.sub: É muito comum em textos de história e em museus: The tower had been saved. O agente raramente importa, por isso o passivo é natural.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Had been + participle says an action was done before another past moment.
“It had been built” means it was not finished.
items.why: It means it was finished earlier.

items.s: The agent is often left out in this structure.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Had been + participle says an action was done before another past mom… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“It had been built” means it was not finished. → Falso (It means it was finished earlier.)
The agent is often left out in this structure. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

Ana wants to understand how the city grew so fast. Mo has visited the museum before and knows the story. They read the signs and compare dates.

“Ana, look at this photo. This landmark had been built long before the railway reached Manchester.” says Mo. “Really?
